scope: Exploratory model-only deposition comparison. No post-hoc accuracy gate, physical calibration, stiffness validation or printability acceptance. Oblique/overhung cases intentionally omit supports.

measurement_checks: positive role deposition agrees with slicer total within 0.03 mm
protocol.transform: STL vertices @ print-to-global rotation matrix; subtract XYZ minima and center XY at (128,128) mm. Matches OpenFEA global-to-print row-vector convention. Slicer arrangement and orientation are disabled.
